title: Frontend Developer
description: Develop and maintain responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Collaborate with designers and backend developers to deliver high-quality web experiences. Optimize applications for performance and accessibility.

title: Backend Developer
description: Design, develop, and maintain server-side applications and REST APIs. Work with databases, ensure security best practices, and collaborate closely with frontend teams to integrate APIs efficiently.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Own end-to-end development of web applications, from frontend UI to backend services. Architect scalable solutions, review code, and mentor junior developers while ensuring best engineering practices.

title: JavaScript Developer
description: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient JavaScript code. Improve application performance, fix bugs, and work closely with product teams to implement new features.

title: UI Developer
description: Convert design mockups into pixel-perfect user interfaces. Ensure cross-browser compatibility and collaborate with UX designers to enhance visual consistency.

title: Web Developer
description: Maintain existing websites, implement small feature updates, and fix UI bugs. Ideal role for developers looking to gain hands-on experience with real-world projects.

title: Software Engineer
description: Design and develop scalable software systems. Participate in code reviews, improve system reliability, and work closely with cross-functional teams.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Implement modern frontend features using JavaScript. Focus on performance, reusability, and maintainability while working in an agile environment.

title: Junior Web Developer
description: Assist senior developers in building and debugging web applications. Learn best practices, participate in code reviews, and grow technical skills.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: Lead frontend architecture decisions, build complex UI components, and mentor junior developers. Ensure high performance and accessibility standards.

title: React Developer
description: Develop interactive and scalable user interfaces. Work closely with designers and backend teams to deliver seamless user experiences.

title: Web Designer
description: Design visually appealing layouts and improve overall website aesthetics. Collaborate with developers to ensure design feasibility.

title: Frontend Intern
description: Learn frontend development by working on real projects. Assist in building UI components and fixing minor issues under mentorship.

title: Software Developer
description: Implement business logic and application features. Collaborate with QA and product teams to ensure smooth delivery.

title: UI Engineer
description: Build scalable and accessible UI systems. Define UI standards and improve consistency across products.

title: JavaScript Engineer
description: Optimize JavaScript performance across applications. Lead technical decisions and ensure code quality.

title: Frontend Tester
description: Test UI components, identify bugs, and ensure consistent behavior across browsers and devices.

title: Product Engineer
description: Work closely with product managers to build features that solve real user problems. Focus on performance and scalability.

title: Web Application Developer
description: Develop and maintain modern web applications. Ensure security, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.

title: UI/UX Developer
description: Improve user experience through thoughtful UI development. Conduct usability improvements and collaborate with design teams.
